newsitem.title: USA: LG&E set to bid on Big Rivers assets.
newsitem.headline: LG&E set to bid on Big Rivers assets.

text.p: LG&E Energy Corp said Monday it has approved LG&E Energy replacing Pacificorp in the existing reorganization plan of Big Rivers Electric. This, said the company, is the first step required by the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for LG&E Energy to participate in a March auction of Big Rivers, protecting creditors and customers should Pacificorp choose to abandon its bid.

LG&E Energy said it will match the offer currently proposed by Pacificorp to lease the assets of the Henderson, Ky.-based power cooperative and provide for the long-term power needs of Big Rivers' customers.

Having met the court's requirements to begin its due diligence review of Big Rivers, LG&E said it has until the March 19 bid date to determine the amount of any potential enhanced bid for the lease or purchase of Big Rivers' assets.
LG&E Energy Corp. is an energy services holding company headquartered in Louisville, Ky with assets and operations in retail and wholesale power and natural gas services and marketing.
